coverage.blank_native_and_pwm: All Master occurrences in the official project and sibling library, separated by static reachability from Main; native TLine/Cable/Bus objects are recorded separately.
coverage.blank_recipe: Semantic roles only; the executable blank/native path clones the official template pair.
coverage.fixed_avm_and_catalog: All Master component entries, net endpoints, and catalog coverage in the packaged asset set.
limitations: Port conditions and parent parameter expressions are retained without evaluation.
Definition occurrences are not expanded runtime instance counts.
Static presence does not prove physical behavior, compilation, or simulation.
No arbitrary user template or future generated companion is covered.
coverage.packaged_companion: All internal Master references in the repository contract XML. This is not native PSCAD Definition XML.
coverage.parametric_avm: All Python Master literals and parameter update dictionaries in the AVM adapter.
coverage.scenario_control: Existing template control components are included through the native graph; native scenario code edits parameters, not new Master definitions. Future WP3 insertion is undefined.

native_template.reachability_semantics: Static User/Wire definition graph, not expanded instance counts or evaluated conditional activity.
